ChangeAccessPassword.password: Password must be 8–16 characters long and contain at least two of the following: letters, numbers, and special characters. Allowed special characters include $^\*\(\)\_\+\-=. The password must be transmitted in encrypted form; plaintext transmission is prohibited.
